INSERT INTO pairwise_votes (voter_id, winner_id, loser_id)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
         ON CONFLICT (voter_id, LEAST(winner_id, loser_id), GREATEST(winner_id, loser_id))
             DO UPDATE SET winner_id = EXCLUDED.winner_id,
                           loser_id = EXCLUDED.loser_id,
                           created_at = now()
